jobs.title: Case Manager / Counselor - (Bachelor's) Hamilton & McMinn
jobs.description:
Now Hiring: Case Managers, Counselors, Specialists, and Mental Health Techs

Location: Hamilton & McMinn Counties, Tennessee

Start Your Career with Purpose – Join the McNabb Center Today!

We’ve been waiting for someone like you!

With numerous opportunities across Hamilton and McMinn Counties
, the McNabb Center invites you to become part of a mission-driven team dedicated to “Improving the lives of the people we serve.” If you're seeking a bachelor’s level position
providing support to clients in our clinics or out in the community, explore the opportunities below and apply today!

Non-Residential Positions

Case Managers

Case Managers at McNabb Center deliver integrated, person-centered care by developing treatment plans tailored to each client’s unique needs and goals. Working with a defined caseload, Case Managers help clients navigate systems of care, provide essential support, and advocate on their behalf.

Examples Of Case Manager Roles Include

HealthLink Care Coordinator
Hamilton Co. Jail to Work Case Manager

Starting Pay:
$19.54 / hour (based on education, experience, and position)

Caseloads and client needs vary by program and may impact pay rates and work expectations.

Specialists & Counselors

Specialists and Counselors provide essential services such as information and referrals, advocacy, home visits, and individualized goal support. Programs serve a wide range of client needs—from child development and family support to HIV education and justice-involved youth.

Examples Of Positions Include

OnTrack Peer Support Specialist
TMI Peer Recovery Specialist
Child Development Specialist
CYHOP Case Manager

Note:
Many of these roles involve transportation of clients. A valid driver’s license with F-endorsement
is required.

Starting Pay:
$17.97 / hour (based on education, experience, and position)

Caseloads and client needs vary by program and may impact pay rates and work expectations.

Mental Health Techs

Mental Health Techs support clients within Supportive Housing facilities
that operate 24/7. This direct-care role includes monitoring clients, completing intakes, facilitating groups, conducting safety checks, and providing a structured, supportive environment. Transportation of clients is also required.

Work Schedule:
Shift-based (Evenings, Overnights, Weekends, Holidays)

Shift Differential Pay
available for 2nd and 3rd shifts.

Starting Pay (Bachelor’s Level)

$19.35 / hour (Full-Time)

Client population, education, experience, and acuity level influence starting rate.

High School-level positions also available—see separate posting.

Why Join the McNabb Center?

Mission-Driven Work that directly impacts lives in your community
Competitive Starting Pay and shift differentials
PRN / As-Needed Options for flexible scheduling
Professional Development and potential for career growth
NHSC-Approved Site – eligibility for student loan repayment programs

General Requirements

Valid Driver’s License and reliable transportation required for nearly all positions
F-Endorsement required for roles involving client transportation
Caseloads, client acuity, and on-call requirements may impact salary
PRN pay rates may vary by program

Apply Now

We’ve been waiting for someone like you.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates globally in the healthcare sector, focusing on improving health outcomes by connecting individuals with care, pharmacy benefits, data, and resources to support healthier lives. It leverages technology to deliver care and serves communities by advancing health optimization on a broad scale.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Pharmacy Care Coordinator plays a key role in engaging with patients, providers, pharmacies, and insurance companies to support medication management and adherence. This position contributes to the organization''s mission by fostering trust and collaboration across stakeholders, ensuring accurate medication information, and advocating for patient needs.

3.Responsibilities:
• Gather and document medication information in software systems
• Record Pharmacist interventions accurately
• Act as liaison between care clinicians and pharmacy teams
• Collaborate with internal and external departments
• Support administrative tasks for tracking and reporting metrics
• Operate effectively in a moderate to fast-paced environment
• Communicate with patients, providers, and vendors to obtain medication therapy information
• Participate in medication adherence outreach efforts
• Utilize pharmacy technology and computer systems to complete pharmacy tasks
• Apply knowledge of customer service principles and legal regulations related to pharmacy
• Use logic and reasoning to evaluate solutions and approaches
• Demonstrate advanced verbal and written communication skills
• Identify process improvement opportunities
• Manage organization and time efficiently
• Assist with data management and reporting
• Update job knowledge through educational opportunities
• Perform other assigned duties and projects

4. Requirements:
• High School Diploma or GED
• Active and unrestricted Pharmacy Technician License in Nevada
• Minimum 3 years experience as a Pharmacy Technician
• At least 1 year experience in customer service
• Familiarity with medical and pharmacy terminology
• Knowledge of medication therapeutic categories
• Ability to identify generic and brand name drugs
• Understanding of medication indications
• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office and Windows applications

Preferred qualifications:
• Experience in hospital, ambulatory care, or healthcare settings
• Experience in managed care
• Skilled in conducting patient assessments
• Ability to manage time and tasks efficiently
• Ability to work independently

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• Hourly pay ranges from $18 to $32 based on full-time employment
• Compensation depends on factors such as local labor markets, education, experience, and certifications
• Benefits include a comprehensive package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase, and 401(k) contributions, subject to eligibility

6. Benefits & Perks:
• Paid Time Off starting from the first pay period plus eight paid holidays
• Medical plan options with Health Spending or Health Saving accounts
• Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D insurance
• Short-term and Long-term Disability coverage
• 401(k) Savings Plan
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• Education reimbursement
• Employee discounts
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Referral Bonus Program
• Voluntary benefits including pet insurance, legal insurance, and long-term care insurance

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:
RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.

jobs.title: Case Manager ( RN )
jobs.description:
We are a compassionate company driven by a personal commitment to exceptional care. Founded by the grandchildren of a former Department of Energy worker, we elevate the lives of energy workers with unwavering compassion and whole-person care.

Our mission is guided by our founders' deep commitment to high-quality care under the Energy Employees Occupational Illness Compensation Program Act (EEOICPA). With over 14 years of experience and operations across 24 states, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of energy workers and their families.

We are seeking a skilled Registered Nurse Case Manager
to join our team. This role is crucial in assessing patient needs, coordinating care, and ensuring effective communication among all parties involved in patient care.

Responsibilities

Manage Nursing Care: Oversee the coordination of nursing care, home health aide services, and applicable therapies once approved by the Department of Labor.
Ensure Confidentiality: Maintain confidentiality of all client and office records in accordance with HIPAA guidelines and the Privacy Act PHI.
Facilitate Communication: Ensure effective communication and collaboration among the care team to provide cohesive and comprehensive care.
Additional Duties: Perform other duties as assigned to support the team and enhance patient care.

Qualifications

Current RN License: Valid and active Registered Nurse license in good standing.
Experience: At least one year of experience in a home health setting, or related area, with strong assessment skills.
Organizational Skills: Excellent organizational and time management skills to handle multiple clients efficiently.
Tech Savvy: Proficient in computer and internet-based applications, as well as office equipment.
Equipment Knowledge: Competent working knowledge of client-based equipment.
Background Check: Must pass a criminal background check and sanction screening.
Professional Appearance: Professional demeanor and appearance are necessary.

Pay Range

USD $40.00 - USD $45.00 /Hr.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Programs
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization is a membership-based philanthropic entity focused on promoting responsive and transformative investments in Black communities. Partnering with foundations, nonprofits, and individuals, it provides professional development and technical assistance to enhance the philanthropic sector’s attention to equality, diversity, and inclusion. Established in 1971 as the Association of Black Foundation Executives, it has evolved from an all-volunteer group credited with early diversity advances in philanthropy into a fully staffed and influential network serving a broad membership.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Program Manager supports the development, coordination, and execution of the organization’s programs and learning initiatives. The role works closely with program leadership to advance programming and professional development goals, ensuring key activities and projects led by the Programs Department are successfully implemented. This position contributes to the organization''s impact by managing major initiatives and supporting cross-departmental collaboration.

3.Responsibilities:
• Manage timelines and assist in meeting deliverables on schedule and quality standards.
• Oversee and implement the Gladys K. Washington Connecting Leaders Fellowship Program, including managing executive coaching, application processes, committees, events, and vendor relationships.
• Collaborate with conference management to plan and execute the annual conference, aligning content, logistics, budgets, and timelines.
• Manage the call for sessions for the annual conference and assist in content curation for other programs.
• Serve as liaison for staff and speakers/presenters for programs and events.
• Support coordination and implementation of programs and initiatives led by the Programs Department.
• Prepare and submit quarterly program reports on activities, outcomes, and participant engagement.
• Maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders including networks, partners, and members.
• Support program evaluation and assessment efforts.
• Coordinate with marketing and communications to promote program activities and maintain web content.
• Facilitate program meetings, document decisions and action items, and ensure follow-up.
• Manage program-related financial activities including invoice processing and budget monitoring.

4. Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and professional experience.
• Four to six years of progressive experience in nonprofit program management, administration, or project coordination.
• Preferably experience in philanthropy, racial equity, social justice, or mission-driven nonprofits.
• Commitment to the organization’s mission and understanding of racial equity principles.
• Strong project management, organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
• Experience managing consultants, vendors, and external partners.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CRM systems like Salesforce, project management tools (e.g., Asana), virtual meeting platforms, email marketing, database management, and digital communication tools.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• Salary range: $73,500.00 to $84,000.00

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.
